Meet the all-new BMW 3 Series! 

Mat's flown over to Germany for his chance to get hands-on with the new 3 Series and all-electric BMW i3. 

So the question is, just how different is the all-electric i3 compared to the petrol-powered 3 Series? And if you’re in the market for one of these newly released exports, which should you go for? Let’s take a closer look… 

From the outside, the two versions look almost identical. Up front, both cars have the Neue Klasse-inspired front end, which features a kidney grille design flanked on either side by thin headlights. In M350 guise, there are optional yellow DRLs as well, coupled with a sportier lower bumper. Both cars look almost identical from the side, while around the back, the M350 comes with a small bootleg spoiler, a fake diffuser, and a set of quad tailpipes - and they’re all real!
